architecture.eight_legs: 4 hot hydrogen orange + 4 cold nitrogen blue
architecture.optical: 16 spatial modes, 48 passive couplers, 32 trainable mesh phases
architecture.checkpoint: meshPhases snapshot freezes network used for reference and feedback; new training affects unfrozen mesh but not existing calibration

limitations: Simulated deterministic optical transfer only, not fabricated hardware
Stress loads are predefined software 96-bit register states rather than real external detector traces
Calibration sees only intensity mismatch but test harness defines underlying synthetic perturbation
Each profile is evaluated against a fixed neutral reference through a frozen trained mesh; full out-of-generator generalization not established
Optical phase is not uniquely identifiable from intensity alone
Stress profiles are disclosed to auditor but not directly read by calibration optimizer
next: PHOTON-16 v0.12: streaming adaptive calibration under time-varying drift with strict observation-only causal measurements and resource budget.
